reviews.text:
Roscoe Village Animal Hospital is wonderful!  They provide excellent care.  The staff is professional and kind.  We have seen all the doctors however Dr. Mursuli has been the one we see the most.  She truly cares about our kitties and spends a lot of time during their exams asking questions and getting to know each of them.  We learned a while ago we share a passion for soccer.  Our daughter plays in college (as did she) and always asks how she's doing.  She makes our visits personal and relatable.

Thank you Dr. Mursuli and everyone at Roscoe Village Animal Hospital!
RVAH has helped with 5+ cats of mine and friends. They are knowledgeable, helpful, caring, and have an inclusive atmosphere.

Always have the best experience at Roscoe Village Animal Hospital! Scheduling appointments is easy, the staff loves my dog, and they’re always so patient with her. As a first-time dog owner, I really appreciate how they take extra time to answer all of my questions. Can’t recommend them enough!

Welcome to RVAH! Thank you for the 5 star -review, Jill. We appreciate your support and for choosing Dr Turkel and our team at Roscoe Village Animal Hospital team to care for your sweet cat.  We hope Biscuit is feeling better.🐾💕
Kim Orr, LVT
Hospital Manager
Roscoe Village Animal Hospital

Dr Garrison spent a lot of time answering questions about my dog’s PRP and discussing possible second steps. My dog was completely calm despite receiving several injections. The environment is always spotless and we never have to wait long.
Cutting edge treatment capabilities, friendly staff, weekend appointments. I moved to the suburbs and still come into the city to RVAH for all my vet needs. Highly recommended.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Roscoe Village Animal Hospital.

I have been with this practice essentially from the beginning. I was a patient of Dr. Rovner’s back when he was still at Higgins, before Roscoe Village Animal Hospital even opened, so between him and RVAH, they have cared for my animals for close to 30 years. Dr. Rovner was absolutely incredible with every animal I brought to him, and they all adored him. When he retired, I will admit that I was nervous about the transition. After trusting someone with my animals for that many years, change is hard!

I could not be happier with the care we have continued to receive. Cristina, the new DVM, has been absolutely wonderful, and every other veterinarian and staff member I have interacted with has been fantastic as well. They are incredibly kind, patient, knowledgeable, and most importantly, they are SO good with my dog.

There was a period when I lived out of state and had to use other veterinary practices, and it made me appreciate RVAH even more. The level of care simply was not the same. In fact, having access to Roscoe Village Animal Hospital again was genuinely one of the reasons I moved back to Illinois.

My dog recently had surgery, and I will freely admit that I turn into a complete ball of nerves when something is wrong with one of my animals. I ask a million questions, I worry about everything, and I know I can be a little bit much! Everyone at RVAH has been unbelievably patient and kind with me through the entire process. They have answered my questions, reassured me when I needed it, kept me informed, and never once made me feel like I was bothering them even though i genuinely was being too much.

After nearly 30 years of trusting this practice with animals that mean the world to me, I think one of the biggest compliments I can give is that even through such a major transition, I still feel like my dog is in incredibly good hands.

I am so grateful to Cristina and the entire team at Roscoe Village Animal Hospital for everything they have done for us. I truly cannot recommend them highly enough. ❤️

I have been taking my dogs to Roscoe Village Animal Hospital (RVAH) for more than a decade. I have seen the evolution of the hospital and its services. I have always been very happy with the care that my dogs received and the staff is also warm and lovely. I take one of my dogs monthly for treatment and have gotten to know many of the staff members in the process. RVAH is a wonderful place to take your pets for their care and I definitely recommend them!
This place is the best! They’ve taken care of all 6 of my pets!

Love Dr.Turkel. She treats both my pup and kitty and treats them with such care. The best part about this clinic is the efficient visits. I am usually in and out under 45 minutes, compared to the usual 1.5+ hr waits at other clinics. I also really appreciate Dr.Turkel’s non-shame based care

I've been going to RVAH since 2014, and I recommend them to people all the time! Over the years, I've probably seen each of the vets at least once, and it's one of the few vet offices where if my regular doctor is out, I feel fully confident and comfortable booking with whichever vet has availability. The staff and vet techs are all so kind and compassionate, and my pets have always received such thoughtful and wonderful care.

My vet, Dr Garrison, is great!  But the prices are shockingly high.  Although maybe they charge the standard prices. I don’t know because I’ve been going here since they opened.  I may have been the first client.
I thought yearly shots and checkup was like $200-$300, but it’s now $675, although I also bought three heart/flea chews that were $50 each.
I’m happy with my vet, and all those that work there, so I’m not going to shop around to save a little and hope the service is the same quality.
The only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is the prices. No complaints with the vets, staff, or facility. Well, one small complaint about the facility, there’s no parking and rarely a spot available on Clybourn

I came to this Vet because my own does not do surgeries and my small dog required a blade surgery. While this vet could do the procedure, our vet Dr. Callahan saw that my dog needed more emergent care. I took my pet to an emergency vet but Dr. Callahan called ahead and sent records making our transition smooth. She was patient and helpful even when I was sobbing in the room. I am considering making this our regular vet. They were all so helpful and professional. Absolutely recommend.

Holly, Thank you for your 5-star review. We are happy to know you had a great experience with our team. We look forward to seeing you again.
Kim Orr, LVT
Hospital Manager 
Roscoe Village Animal Hospital

So, my pup was diagnosed with a bladder issue that required surgery (which my regular vet doesn’t do). I googled this vet and decided to try to go to see if they could do the surgery. They ended up not doing it as it was in my pets best interest to go back to the emergency vet. They were very detailed and thoughtful through my whole time there. Dr. Callahan was wonderful. I was very distraught at one point and they stayed calm and patient. Just what I needed. Even though they didn’t do the surgery, I appreciate them for the care the did provide.

Nicole, thank you for your positive rating! We're glad you had a great experience with us.
We appreciate you choosing RVAH to care for your pet.

Kim Orr, LVT
Hospital Manager
Roscoe Village Animal Hospital
Always a great experience every time we arrive. The staff are friendly and Dr Garrison has always treated my pup great. Pictured is his first visit with him.
Dr. Garrison and the staff has always taken amazing care of my dogs.  My Britney can be a lot and they so patient.  I highly recommend them.

We have brought all our dogs here they are theee best ❤️caring loving and understanding I had a senior dog and we took that ride TOGETHER til the very end they always kept things 100 about his condition later we had another dog who had bone cancer and we also took that ride together lastly now we have Richie who ABSOLUTELY LOVES the entire staff here because they love him right back during Covid when we couldn’t walk in Richie would WILLINGLY walk in with them and not look back BEST SIGN FOR ME 7 years later he still loves his vet Ms. Turkel ❤️ thank you from rip Peluchin  & Alvin Santos and now from Richie Santos 🤞🏻
